    96:             namespace: "{{ connect_secret_namespace }}"

   138:         definition: "{{ lookup('kubernetes.core.kustomize', dir=gitops_repo ~ '//clusters/' ~ gitops_cluster ~ '?ref=' ~ gitops_ref, enable_helm=true) }}"

    70:         content: "{{ _deployed.secrets[0].SecretData }}"

    73:       # needs no privilege and the EE has no sudo.

    77:         # defaults to ssh, intentionally - armbian builds SSH back into it), so
    78:         # a bare delegate_to: localhost tries to ssh into the EE, which has no

    93:         letsencrypt_needs_issue: >-
    94:           {{ (letsencrypt_force_issue | default(false) | bool)
    95:              or (_deployed is skipped)
    96:              or ((letsencrypt_remaining_days | int) < (_renew_days | int)) }}
    97: 
    98:     - name: Report the decision
    99:       ansible.builtin.debug:
   100:         msg: >-

   109: # "Publish" task loops over EVERY challenge value, using solo only on the first
   110: # per record (clears stale, then appends) - the multi-value handling Cloudflare
   111: # needs. TXT records are torn down in always:, even if validation fails.
   112: - name: Issue the certificate on the control node (Cloudflare DNS-01)
   113:   hosts: "{{ cert_hosts | default('letsencrypt') }}"
   114:   gather_facts: false
   115:   connection: local
   116:   become: false
   117: 
   118:   vars:
   119:     # This play runs locally but targets the remote host, whose discovered
   120:     # interpreter would otherwise be used; pin to the controller's interpreter.
   121:     ansible_python_interpreter: "{{ ansible_playbook_python }}"
   122:     _keys_path: "{{ acme_keys_path | default('/tmp/acme-' ~ inventory_hostname) }}"
   123:     _cert_basename: "{{ letsencrypt_cert_domains[0] | replace('*', '_') }}"
   124:     _acme_directory: "{{ letsencrypt_acme_directory | default('https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory') }}"
   125: 
   126:   tasks:
   127:     - name: Nothing to issue when no renewal is needed
   128:       ansible.builtin.meta: end_host
   129:       when: not (letsencrypt_needs_issue | default(false) | bool)
   130: 
   131:     # Resolve each 1Password secret exactly ONCE. As play vars these lookups are
   132:     # lazy and re-run on every reference (and every loop item), bursting the 1P
   133:     # service-account rate limit; materialize them up front and reuse the facts.
   134:     # The shared ACME account is read on the control node only (never reaches
   135:     # the host).
   136:     - name: Resolve issuance secrets from 1Password (once)
   137:       ansible.builtin.set_fact:
   138:         _account_content: "{{ lookup('community.general.onepassword', 'acme-key', field='key.b64', vault='lab_external_api_keys') | b64decode }}"
   139:         _account_email: "{{ lookup('community.general.onepassword', 'acme-key', field='email', vault='lab_external_api_keys') }}"
   140:         _cf_token: "{{ acme_certificate_cloudflare_token }}"
   141:       no_log: true
   142: 
   143:     - name: Ensure the scratch keys directory exists on the control node
   144:       ansible.builtin.file:
   145:         path: "{{ _keys_path }}"
   146:         state: directory
   147:         mode: "0700"
   148: 
   149:     # Fresh keypair each issuance - keys_path is a throwaway scratch dir, so no
   150:     # private key persists on the controller (the delivery play removes it).
   151:     - name: Generate the certificate private key
   152:       community.crypto.openssl_privatekey:
   153:         path: "{{ _keys_path }}/{{ _cert_basename }}.key"
   154:         type: RSA
   155:         size: 4096
   156:         mode: "0600"
   157:         force: true
   158: 
   159:     - name: Generate the CSR with all SANs (wildcard + apex)
   160:       community.crypto.openssl_csr:
   161:         path: "{{ _keys_path }}/{{ _cert_basename }}.csr"
   162:         privatekey_path: "{{ _keys_path }}/{{ _cert_basename }}.key"
   163:         subject_alt_name: "{{ letsencrypt_cert_domains | map('regex_replace', '^(.*)$', 'DNS:\\1') | list }}"
   164:         use_common_name_for_san: false
   165: 
   166:     - name: Ensure the shared ACME account exists (terms agreed)
   167:       community.crypto.acme_account:
   168:         account_key_content: "{{ _account_content }}"
   169:         contact: ["mailto:{{ _account_email }}"]
   170:         terms_agreed: true
   171:         allow_creation: true
   172:         state: present
   173:         acme_directory: "{{ _acme_directory }}"
   174:         acme_version: 2
   175: 
   176:     - name: Create the ACME order and read the DNS-01 challenges
   177:       community.crypto.acme_certificate_order_create:
   178:         account_key_content: "{{ _account_content }}"
   179:         csr: "{{ _keys_path }}/{{ _cert_basename }}.csr"
   180:         acme_directory: "{{ _acme_directory }}"
   181:         acme_version: 2
   182:       register: _order
   183: 
   184:     # challenge_data_dns is {record_name: [values...]}; apex + wildcard collapse
   185:     # to one _acme-challenge.<domain> key whose list holds BOTH tokens.
   186:     - name: Publish, validate, then always tear down the challenge records
   187:       block:
   188:         - name: Publish every challenge TXT value to Cloudflare
   189:           community.general.cloudflare_dns:
   190:             api_token: "{{ _cf_token }}"
